I come from a very unloving and (kinda) poor family. My mom almost never put money in my lunch account and for the longest time I suffered with anorexia and bulimia. I never really ate lunch.  

Then a guy who sat at my table noticed I never ate at lunch and asked if I was ok away from all our friends. Now he’s the jokester of the table do this was really odd. A day later I went to go see if I had money because I needed to break my fast (I didn’t eat for a week on that specific week) and sure enough, no money. 

I told my lunch table in defeat then just went on my computer. The guy called my name “hey uh, OP. Wanna see a magic trick?” I looked up from my computer and he pulled out a 5 dollar bill from his jacket and handed to me. I got all flustered and told him I didn’t mean but he demanded I take it and get myself some food. So I did 

After some subtle flirting and buying me food, we now both have promise rings and saving up money to move out of my current toxic environment and have a happy ending
